method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record and all three official attachments. Downloaded and extracted each original, compared checksums and substantive content, and rendered the two image-only signed-resolution copies page by page.

matter.title: Approving the Programming of Funds and Projects for the 2023-2032 Decade Plan for Capital Improvements Including the 2023 Two-Year Capital Budget

attachments.title: R-23-100 original resolution packet
attachments.reason: The original bill has tracked legislative changes and a mixed supporting packet. Its proposed allocations differ from the enacted committee substitute, so it is not the governing 2023-2032 Decade Plan resolution.

attachments.title: C/S R-23-100 committee substitute
attachments.reason: This is the unsigned committee substitute. Its governing successor is the signed enacted C/S R-23-100 retained as the canonical resolution.

attachments.title: R-2023-032 enacted C/S R-23-100
attachments.reason: Different PDF bytes from the canonical City OnBase/Legistar copy, but every one of the nine rendered pages is pixel-identical. This is the same signed R-2023-032 and is retained once as the canonical original.

result: Retain the existing signed R-2023-032 canonical original once. The original bill packet and unsigned committee substitute are superseded; the separately downloaded enacted attachment is the same signed record delivered with different PDF bytes.
